structs.notes: Replay layout proven from raw displacements (disassembly), not from IDA's typed decompile names: the decompiler renders some auth-token accesses through IDA's old offsets (e.g. m_authToken._pad68[8]) but the raw instructions are [r14+128h] / [rbx+128h] = +296 and [r14+12Ch] / [rbx+12Ch] = +300. Result: the IDA layout is 8 bytes too wide from +16 on because GT m_config (NetConfig *) is absent in Replay. Proposal: retype the whole struct to this 304-byte layout (size change, so coordinator only). Note for the NetInit owner: NetInit.m_relay is a 272-byte blob at +64; NetRelay_ctor is only called from NetRegistry_InitGlobal@0x1412bc010, which places NetRelay at registry+0x10, so NetInit.m_relay is not this object. NetRelayOverride is at registry+0x140 and is not part of this struct. Enums to use: ConnectState values seen 0,2,3,4,5,6; AuthTokenState values seen 1,2,3 (0 cleared in Reset).
